g.text: Low-side opening does NOT isolate BAT_PLUS. Reverse insertion, current/thermal margins and fault leakage remain OPEN.

g.desc: Low-side opening does NOT isolate BAT_PLUS. Reverse insertion, current/thermal margins and fault leakage remain OPEN.

g.text: No PWR_FLAG, no ERC exclusions, no production footprint claims.

g.desc: No PWR_FLAG, no ERC exclusions, no production footprint claims.

g.text: BAT_MINUS is isolated from system GND by Q501/R506/Q502. NEVER bridge it with a debug, shield or ground connection.

g.desc: BAT_MINUS is isolated from system GND by Q501/R506/Q502. NEVER bridge it with a debug, shield or ground connection.

g.text: R501 is a positive power link; R601 is the ONLY gauge shunt. Protector bias/filter/gate drive bypass R601 and are audited.

g.desc: R501 is a positive power link; R601 is the ONLY gauge shunt. Protector bias/filter/gate drive bypass R601 and are audited.

g.text: R506 contributes to delayed overcurrent detection, NOT a5A clamp. First insertion may require charger/service arming.

g.desc: R506 contributes to delayed overcurrent detection, NOT a5A clamp. First insertion may require charger/service arming.

g.text: CANDIDATE WIRED: BQ29700 low-side guard. Startup, load/thermal and PCM coordination OPEN; charging locked OFF.

g.desc: CANDIDATE WIRED: BQ29700 low-side guard. Startup, load/thermal and PCM coordination OPEN; charging locked OFF.
